# Build Vibe

> Build Vibe is an AI website and app builder for creating verified, portable websites, web applications and mobile product foundations.

## What it does

- Generate websites, SaaS products, ecommerce stores, dashboards, portals and mobile app foundations from natural-language requirements.
- Use Design Mode for visual tokens, responsive layout, motion, accessibility and experience direction.
- Verify generated output with source checks, application tests, HTTP/browser verification and bounded repair before commit.
- Publish verified output through supported providers or export the source tree.

## Trust and implementation notes

- The public marketing pages are crawlable.
- The authenticated builder workspace is not intended for indexing.
- Product claims should match shipped functionality and configured provider capabilities.
- This file is a supplemental machine-readable index. It is not a substitute for normal SEO, crawlability or Search Console.
